title: System Settings
desc: Configure platform parameters, CAPTCHA engines, SMTP mailer services, and security policies.

general.platform_desc_placeholder: Enter platform summary displayed on home and footer
general.registration_hint: When enabled, visitors can register accounts on the front end; when disabled, accounts can only be created by admins
general.require_email_verification_hint: When enabled, users must verify an email code to register; when disabled, registration relies directly on CAPTCHA

captcha.enabled_hint: When enabled, CAPTCHA is required for login, registration, and sensitive endpoints
captcha.tolerance_hint: Passes if slider drag gap is within tolerance pixels (Recommended 6-10px)
captcha.ticket_ttl_hint: Validity duration for token generated after verification (Default 300s)
captcha.max_attempts_hint: Cooldown lock is triggered if consecutive errors exceed the limit per IP/account
captcha.force_reset_hint: Enforce graphical security verification during password reset flow

mail.from_address_placeholder: For QQ/163 mail, keep same as auth username; for Resend enter verified email
mail.pass_placeholder: Enter email authorization code or SMTP password
mail.ssl_hint: Enable SSL/TLS encrypted transport (Recommended for port 465)
mail.webhook_secret_placeholder: Secret token expected from provider webhook requests (leave empty to disable validation)

maintenance.alert_title: Platform is currently in full maintenance mode
maintenance.alert_desc: Non-admin users cannot access competitions or submit Flags. Please proceed with caution.
maintenance.switch_hint: When enabled, non-admin users cannot participate in competitions or submit Flags
maintenance.notice_placeholder: e.g. Platform undergoing infrastructure maintenance, expected to restore at 04:00.

messages.save_success: System settings saved successfully and hot-reloaded.
messages.test_mail_success: SMTP connectivity test successful, mail service is operational.
messages.test_mail_failed: SMTP connection test failed. Please check mail settings.
messages.from_address_required: Sender email address cannot be empty
